title: Nachos with Corn Salsa
description: Crispy tortilla chips layered with melted cheese and topped with fresh roasted corn salsa create a colorful and flavorful Mexican appetizer. The smoky sweetness of roasted corn perfectly complements the gooey cheese and crunchy chips for a restaurant-quality dish.

ingredients.title: For the Nachos
items: High-quality corn tortilla chips (homemade preferred) – 300 g
Shredded cheese blend (cheddar, Monterey Jack, and Oaxaca) – 200 g
Cooked shredded chicken or slow-cooked beef – 150 g (optional)

ingredients.title: For the Corn Salsa
items: Fresh corn kernels (or roasted if possible) – 1 cup
Small red bell pepper, finely diced – 1
Small red onion, finely diced – ½
Small jalapeño, deseeded and finely chopped – 1

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Corn Salsa
steps: Heat a small skillet over medium heat with 1 tsp olive oil.
Add corn kernels and roast lightly until slightly charred (~5 min).
In a mixing bowl, combine roasted corn, red bell pepper, red onion, jalapeño, and cilantro.
Add lime juice, salt, and pepper. Mix well and set aside to allow flavors to meld.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Season the Nachos
steps: Toss tortilla chips lightly in melted butter, smoked paprika, chili powder, and a pinch of salt.
Spread chips evenly on a baking sheet or oven-safe platter.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble and Bake
steps: Sprinkle shredded cheese evenly over chips.
Add cooked chicken or beef evenly if using.
Bake in the oven for 5–7 minutes, or until cheese melts and becomes slightly bubbly.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finish and Serve
steps: Spoon generous amounts of corn salsa over the top.
Add optional garnishes like sour cream, guacamole, pickled onions, or fresh cilantro.
Serve immediately while warm and crisp.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately while warm and crisp.
Pair with salsa verde, salsa roja, or extra guacamole.
Perfect as an appetizer, party snack, or casual meal.

chefTips: Chips: For ultimate crunch, lightly fry fresh corn tortillas at home instead of store-bought chips.
Cheese: A mix of melting cheeses and a touch of sharp cheddar gives both gooey texture and flavor depth.
Corn Salsa: Roast the corn for a smoky, restaurant-quality taste.
Presentation: Layer toppings carefully to avoid soggy chips and make the dish visually striking.
